3.4.3 New Booking Type Dropdown (Mandatory):
1. In this Booking details, we require a new dropdown as “Booking Type”. It will have two options:- 1. Greige, 2. Finished
2. Greige: If a material line is marked as Greige, this Supplier Block Booking is auto-linked to POs at article level. A PO is linked when all three conditions are met: (1) the PO was created from an OC Indent, (2) that OC is linked to the same Buyer Block Booking this Supplier Booking was created against, and (3) the article matches.
3. Article level means the system matches on the article only. If the articles match, the link is made automatically.
4. Finished: If a material line is marked as Finished, this Supplier Block Booking is auto-linked to POs at article-colour-size level. The same three conditions apply as above, except the match is on article, colour and size.
5. Article-colour-size level means the system matches on article, colour and size together . Only if all three match is the link made automatically.

chunks.title: Purpose
chunks.heading: Purpose
chunks.text: Need to Handle Buyer Blocking Booking based Indent Creation later Indent will be Tagged to Supplier Block booking for Greige Booking. Need to Track Projection end to end.
chunks.locator: § Purpose

chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: Business Requirement
chunks.text:
WFX ERP already supports Buyer Block Booking (a buyer-side projection commitment, e.g. a season's forecast quantity from a buyer such as GAP or Old Navy) and Supplier Block Booking (a supplier-side raw-material booking, typically for Greige fabric) as independent modules. Today these two records are not connected: a Merchandiser captures a buyer's projection and its material requirement on a Buyer Block Booking, and Sourcing separately, manually, re-enters an equivalent material requirement on a new Supplier Block Booking against a chosen supplier.
This Business Requirements is to connect the two end-to-end. On confirmation of a Buyer Block Booking, WFX shall automatically generate an Indent carrying the material requirement, linked back to that Buyer Block Booking. Sourcing shall then be able to select one or more open Indents — including Indents from different buyers, where they share a common supplier — and consolidate them into a single Supplier Block Booking. Combined with the existing Buyer Linked OC Detail and Supplier Linked PO Detail grids, this gives a single, system-traceable chain from a buyer's original projection through to actual fulfilment on both the demand and supply sides.
chunks.locator: § Business Requirement

chunks.title: 3.4.1 Indent Visibility with Consolidated and Detail Views
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › 3.4 Changes to the Supplier Block Booking Screen › 3.4.1 Indent Visibility with Consolidated and Detail Views
chunks.text:
• Currently, since supplier block booking is not linked with any indent. So, there no indent column in this screen.
• Now, as we are connecting indent with Supplier booking so the supplier booking will have visibility of indents and Consolidate and Detail view same as PO.
• When user clicks on Show Details then system will show the indent details as well in Internal Ref Column.
• The new “Internal Ref” Column will Show:- Indent No, Buyer, Style, Block Booking No (Booking Ref)

PD Query: What is the Internal Ref Column, and what value will come in it?
IMPL Ref: Same as RMPO Internal Ref.
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirements › 3.4 Changes to the Supplier Block Booking Screen › 3.4.1 Indent Visibility with Consolidated and Detail Views

chunks.title: 3.4.2 New Indent Qty and Open Qty Columns
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › 3.4 Changes to the Supplier Block Booking Screen › 3.4.2 New Indent Qty and Open Qty Columns
chunks.text:
• Required two more column in this screen as Indent Qty and Open Qty.
• Indent Qty will only be added in Show Details
• And Open qty will be on both Consolidate and Show Detail.
• Indent Qty:- In Show Details as we are showing the indent no, so it will show the total indent qty for that material
• Open Qty (In Show Detail Tab):- Indent Qty – Any Previous Supplier Booking Qty for that indent
• Open Qty (In Consolidate Tab):- Total Indent Qty (From Show detail) - Any Previous Total Supplier Booking Qty for that
PD Query:
• Are multiple Supplier Block Booking Allowed for single indent?
2. Raw material Indent Qty is of 1000, RMPO of 300 was Made then what would be the Open qty at Supplier block booking and will the RMPO of 300 be linked at Supplier Block booking?

IMPL Remarks:
1. Yes Multiple SBB are allowed.
2. Yes, shows a hyperlink which shows RMPO Created against the Indent.

chunks.title: 3.4.3 New Booking Type Dropdown (Mandatory)
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › 3.4 Changes to the Supplier Block Booking Screen › 3.4.3 New Booking Type Dropdown (Mandatory)
chunks.text:
• In this Booking details, we require a new dropdown as “Booking Type”. It will have two options:- 1. Greige, 2. Finished
• Greige: If a material line is marked as Greige, this Supplier Block Booking is auto-linked to POs at article level. A PO is linked when all three conditions are met: (1) the PO was created from an OC Indent, (2) that OC is linked to the same Buyer Block Booking this Supplier Booking was created against, and (3) the article matches.
• Article level means the system matches on the article only. If the articles match, the link is made automatically.
• Finished: If a material line is marked as Finished, this Supplier Block Booking is auto-linked to POs at article-colour-size level. The same three conditions apply as above, except the match is on article, colour and size.
• Article-colour-size level means the system matches on article, colour and size together . Only if all three match is the link made automatically.
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirements › 3.4 Changes to the Supplier Block Booking Screen › 3.4.3 New Booking Type Dropdown (Mandatory)

chunks.title: 3.5 Business Rules and Validations – Table 3
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › 3.5 Business Rules and Validations
chunks.text:
Columns: Rule (text); Behaviour (text)
Rule | Behaviour
Indent generation | Only on BB confirmation, never draft
Supplier match | All Indents combined into one SBB must share the same Supplier (exact master value) — mismatch blocks
Currency match | Indent lines' Material Details currency must match across selection — mismatch blocks
Qty to Book ceiling | Can never exceed the Indent line's Remaining Qty — blocked with validation if attempted
Rate ceiling | SBB line Rate can never exceed the Indent line's Rate — can only be equal or lower
BB Qty reduction (post-consumption) | Blocked if it would go below cumulative qty already consumed via SBB(s)
BB Rate reduction (post-consumption) | Blocked entirely once any SBB exists against its Indent — even a small amount
Deleting a Material Details line | Treated as reducing qty to zero — same block applies if any qty consumed
BB Cancel | Blocked while any active (not cancelled/short-closed) SBB is linked to its Indent
BB Short Close | Blocked unless all linked SBBs are Cancelled or Short Closed
BB Cancel/Short Close w/ no active SBB | Also cancels/short-closes the Indent + remaining open lines
SBB Cancel | Releases consumed qty back to Indent's Remaining Qty (re-enters queue)
SBB Short Close | Does not release qty; booking locked at final qty; no further PO linking
Qty reservation | Reserved the instant it's added to an SBB (draft or confirmed); released only if the SBB is abandoned unsaved
Concurrency | Two Sourcing users can't reserve the same Indent quantity simultaneously
Manual SBB lines | Exempt from Qty/Rate ceiling; show blank Indent No./BB No./Buyer
Indent removal from queue | Only when its full original qty is fully consumed

chunks.title: 3.4.4 Consumed Qty against Greige Booking.
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › 3.5 Business Rules and Validations › 3.4.4 Consumed Qty against Greige Booking.
chunks.text:
When the booking type is greige, and the PO is created for Finished fabric. We need an option to defined the consumed supplier block booking qty of that greige item. By default, the total RMPO qty will be visible in Qty Field. . But user can change it in case block booking is of Greige Type/
This will be in Linked PO Section of the SBB.

chunks.title: Link Booking Request — Yarn to Greige
chunks.heading: Link Booking Request — Yarn to Greige
chunks.text:
Where the booking above was placed for yarn and the merchant now wants to raise a linked booking for greige against that earlier yarn booking, the following applies.
To do this, the merchant tags the greige fabric against the yarn previously selected in the Buyer Block Booking.
By doing so, the merchant defines the approximate greige quantity being booked against the previously booked yarn.
When the sourcing team subsequently creates a new supplier projection, the system displays the yarn projection against that line, and the sourcing team can specify how much quantity is consumed from the previously raised projection.
linked supplier block booking will open detailed view
chunks.locator: § Link Booking Request — Yarn to Greige
